raw_response: {"diagnosis":"silver_transactions has an extra filter, ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours, that silently drops POSTED transactions arriving more than a day late. In the samples, txn_ts is about 3 days before ingest_ts, and txn_id is unique, so there are no duplicates. The extra drops beyond the legitimate REVERSED filter match the alerts.
